auth.note: The server is documented as unauthenticated and listens on localhost by default. Binding it to all interfaces exposes it to the network.

verified.notes: Exercised on Windows 11 with the lms CLI (commit 43d4b26): lms server start listened on port 1234, GET /api/v1/models answered with a models list and /health with a 404, so detection named LM Studio over the generic adapter. Through ezbx gateway serve on the host: the model list, a chat, a streamed chat ending in [DONE], /v1/messages and /v1/responses all answered; the model loaded on first request. lms unload --all and lms server stop worked as listed. /v1/models lists every downloaded model, embedding models included, so the model facts come from the native list instead: its keys are the ids the chat route accepts (checked the same day), max_context_length is the context size, and type embedding is left out. Its capabilities.vision and loaded_instances are not read yet. A server with its API token switched on shows up as a generic OpenAI-compatible server. Not yet checked from a box through Docker Desktop's host alias.
